name: WordWar: 1v1 Word Game
subtitle: Multiplayer Word Guess Battle
promotionalText: Race a live opponent to the hidden word. Fast 1v1 matches, daily challenges and season rewards. Free to play!
whatsNew: New in 1.0.7: tap any player on the leaderboard to see their daily, weekly, monthly and all-time standings, then challenge them to a Classic match or a Mystery duel. They get a notification even when they’re offline. Results now show what the word means.
shortDescription: Multiplayer word guess battle: race a live rival to crack the same hidden word.
description:
Think you’re fast with words? Prove it — live.

WordWar is a real-time 1v1 word game: you and your opponent get the SAME hidden word and race the same clock. Guess in rows of letter tiles — green means right letter, right spot; yellow means right letter, wrong spot. You see your rival’s tile colors update in real time, but never their letters. First to crack it wins.

⚔️ REAL-TIME DUELS
No turn-taking. Both players solve at once while the clock ticks. Read your opponent’s progress from their colors and outrace them.

🏆 RANKED CLIMB
Win to climb eight tiers — Stone, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, Legend. Every match moves your Elo. Seasons reset the ladder so anyone can rise.

🎮 FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic Ranked — race the same word, 1v1
• Mystery Duel — you each submit a word and crack each other’s
• Daily Challenge — one shared word for the whole world, ranked by guess count
• Friends — private live matches by invite or code

⚡ EARN POWER-UPS
Reveal a letter, Scramble your rival’s view, or Lock their power-ups. Earn them through play, win streaks and daily rewards.

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock board themes, victory animations, avatars, nameplates, and profile borders. Full color-blind mode with high-contrast tiles.

📈 TRACK EVERYTHING
Win rate, streaks, rank history, and full match replays so you can study how every duel played out.

Fair by design: the answer never leaves the server, every guess is validated and scored server-side, and all ranking is computed server-side.

Download WordWar and start your first duel in seconds.
